text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime, and the cafeteria is
packed with
people. In the midst of it all
is Нарита Таисин
wearing her trademark
grim expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I should have one more meat dish...
Hmm, I probably
can't eat that much. I
could handle a salad, but I need
the
protein...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
You shouldn't force yourself to eat more than
you want.

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are known for their
ravenous
appetites, but Нарита Таисин is
a comparatively
light eater.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She always ends up eating to the point
of looking
sick, which I can't help but
worry about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Shut your pie hole. I should at least eat
more than
the others since I'm on the
smaller side.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Otherwise... I'll never catch up.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That tenacity of yours is most
excellent!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Hello there! Sorry for the intrusion! But I guess cutting in out of nowhere is what makes me me.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Tachyon... What do you want?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I imagine you won't be very surprised as
to why I
am here, for it is none other
than to request your
assistance with an
experiment!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: No.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Shot down without hesitation! It's
not just
your running that's fast, eh,
Demon Legs?
However, my friend...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Would you change your mind if I told
you that the
medicines I'm sampling out
can help with your
diet woes?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Hear me out. Adjusting your diet is a
crucial
aspect of bulking up.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
As such, I invented two medicines!
Medicine A
significantly speeds up
digestion, and Medicine B
boosts
nutrient absorption!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Now, I know you seek to obtain a certain
body
type, Taishin. So tell me... How do
you truly feel
about this?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just so it's clear, I'm not gonna be your
guinea
pig. If anything, I'm going to be
the one using
you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So you mean to say, we have a deal!
Very well, let
us start the experiment
right awa—
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Telling Нарита Таисин not to do this
likely won't
work since she's so stubborn.
But I should at least
suggest the
safer-sounding one!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Suggest she take the medicine that hastens
digestion.

Suggest she take the medicine that boosts
nutrient absorption.

text_block_list.text:
What are you jumping in for? Whatever.
I was fine
with either choice anyway.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин takes the medicine and,
with a
furrowed brow, downs it in one
go!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No way. This is so cool—I'm getting
hungry! I've
still got room for more food!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Eeexcellent. Nothing warms
my heart
more than great results!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Heh! I can definitely get used to this!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
At first, Нарита Таисин is delighted by
the
medicine's effects, but before long...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Grumble...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ugh, again?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, Taishin! Are you still
hungry? Don't
worry!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll whip you up a midnight snack. Hehe,
eat as
much as you want! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's fine, I don't need more— Creek!
Dammit, I'm
telling you to stop!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What are you jumping in for? Whatever.
I was fine
with either choice anyway.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин takes the medicine and,
with a
furrowed brow, downs it in one
go!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh, I feel like I can run forever. I've got
so much
energy to spare!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She appears to be satisfied with the
medicine's
tangible results.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should use heavier ankle
weights now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It appears she's decided against taking
more of
the medicine after the ordeal
she went through.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I've gained some muscle after all! Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
